text: What the AI gateway enforces on every call. Human & agent access: RBAC by role, group, tool, and action, with a dedicated identity for every agent. Runtime policy: allow, deny, or require approval per tool call and action, enforced inline. AI-ready DLP: PII and secrets masked or blocked before they reach a model or MCP server. Routing & fallback: frontier and self-hosted models, routed to the most cost-effective option. Usage & cost control: real-time spend and hard caps by user, team, agent, and model. Observability & audit: every action and the policy behind it, streamed to Splunk or Datadog.

Every system, already covered. 400+ C1 Connectors, built on Baton, our open-source connector framework, cover nearly every system in the modern stack. Every agent, governed from day one. AI agents act on systems through MCP. 3,000+ C1 MCP Servers route every agent tool call through the same policy engine and audit trail as every human request.
